votes.motion: Council Member Hull, seconded by Council Member Prokopis, moved to approve the consent agenda
Council Member Barney, seconded by Council Member Hull, made a motion to defer a decision on the resolution

Council Member Hull, seconded by Council Member Prokopis, made a motion to authorize the Mayor to negotiate and sign a letter on behalf of the Magna Metro Township Council and with the other metro township mayors in proposing legislation to the Legislature relating to the metro townships’ form of government
Council Member Hull, seconded by Council Member Prokopis, made a motion to authorize the Mayor to sign the interlocal agreement with Salt Lake County for the Community Development Block Grant program
